problems.title: Climbing Stairs
problems.notes: unbounded-knapsack-shaped: choose a step of 1 or 2, unlimited times — the simplest possible intro to this pattern

problems.title: Coin Change
problems.notes: classic unbounded knapsack minimizing count: dp[amt] = min over coins of dp[amt-coin] + 1

problems.title: Coin Change II
problems.notes: counting ways, not minimizing — loop coins in the outer loop and amount inner, or you'll count permutations as distinct

problems.title: Perfect Squares
problems.notes: same shape as Coin Change with the 'coins' being perfect squares up to n

problems.title: Combination Sum IV
problems.notes: order matters here, so it's really a permutations count despite the name — loop amount outer, candidates inner

problems.title: Word Break
problems.notes: unbounded knapsack over strings: dp[i] = true if any dp[j] is true and s[j:i] is in the dictionary

problems.title: Minimum Cost For Tickets
problems.notes: unbounded choice at each travel day among {1-day, 7-day, 30-day} passes, DP only over days you actually travel

problems.title: Form Largest Integer With Digits That Add up to Target
problems.notes: unbounded knapsack maximizing digit count first, then a greedy lexicographic tie-break among equal-length results
